title: PWM Generator (Three-phase, Three-level)
text: Generate three-phase, three-level pulse width modulated signal or waveform for gating switching devices, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, {Sampling mode} sets Wave-sampling method; {Continuous PWM} sets the continuous pulse width modulation method SPWM: sinusoidal, {Switching frequency (Hz)} sets the switching rate 1e3 and {Sample time (s)} sets the block sample time 5e-5. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: vneutral
ports.summary: DC-link neutral point balance control scalar

params.name: Continuous PWM
params.values: Continuous pulse width modulation method SPWM: sinusoidal PWM (default) | SVM: space vector modulation
